title: Symmetry
description: Class 6 IMO — Symmetry: lines of symmetry for shapes and letters, reflection and mirror symmetry, and an introduction to rotational symmetry (order and angle).

topics.title: Lines of Symmetry
topics.concept:
A shape has a line of symmetry if a line divides it into two halves that match exactly, like a mirror. A square has 4 lines of symmetry, a rectangle has 2, an equilateral triangle has 3 and a circle has many.

Letters can be symmetric too — A has a vertical line of symmetry.

examples.problem: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
What kind of line of symmetry does the letter A have?

recap: A line of symmetry gives two matching halves.
Square 4, rectangle 2, equilateral triangle 3, circle many.

quiz.q: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle have?
quiz.explanation: A rectangle has 2 lines of symmetry.

quiz.q: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have?
quiz.explanation: An equilateral triangle has 3 lines of symmetry.

topics.title: Reflection & Mirror Symmetry
topics.concept:
In reflection, a shape and its mirror image are the same distance from the mirror line and face opposite ways. A shape has mirror symmetry if one half is the mirror image of the other.

Letters like H, I, O and X have both a vertical and a horizontal line of symmetry.

examples.problem: Which letter has a vertical line of symmetry: A, F or G?
examples.solution: A — its left and right halves match.

examples.problem: Name a letter with both vertical and horizontal symmetry.

recap: Reflection flips a shape across a mirror line.
H, I, O, X have both vertical and horizontal symmetry.

quiz.q: Which letter has a vertical line of symmetry?
quiz.explanation: The letter A has a vertical line of symmetry.

quiz.q: Which letter has both horizontal and vertical symmetry?
quiz.explanation: H has both a vertical and a horizontal line of symmetry.

topics.title: Rotational Symmetry
topics.concept: A shape has rotational symmetry if it looks the same after turning by some angle less than a full turn. The order is how many times it matches in one full turn. A square has order 4 (turning 90° each time); a rectangle has order 2 (180°); an equilateral triangle has order 3 (120°).

examples.problem: What is the order of rotational symmetry of a square?
What angle do you turn a square so it looks the same?

recap: Order = number of matches in one full turn.
Square order 4 (90°), rectangle order 2 (180°), equilateral triangle order 3 (120°).

quiz.q: What is the order of rotational symmetry of a rectangle?
quiz.explanation: A rectangle matches twice in a full turn, so order 2.

quiz.q: What is the order of rotational symmetry of an equilateral triangle?
quiz.explanation: It matches three times in a full turn, so order 3.

questions.q: Which letter has a vertical line of symmetry?
questions.explanation: The letter A has a vertical line of symmetry.

questions.q: Which is the odd one out (three have at least one line of symmetry)?
questions.explanation: A scalene triangle has no line of symmetry.

questions.q: A square has 4 lines of symmetry; a rectangle has ___ ?
questions.explanation: A rectangle has 2 lines of symmetry.

questions.q: A shape that looks the same after a half turn has rotational symmetry of order ___ ?
questions.explanation: Matching after a 180° (half) turn means order 2.

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 lines of symmetry.

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle have?
questions.explanation: A rectangle has 2 lines of symmetry.

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have?
questions.explanation: An equilateral triangle has 3 lines of symmetry.

questions.q: What is the order of rotational symmetry of a square?
questions.explanation: A square matches four times in a full turn.

questions.q: Through what angle does a square turn to look the same?
questions.explanation: A square has rotational symmetry every 90°.

questions.q: Which letter has both horizontal and vertical symmetry?
questions.explanation: H has both lines of symmetry.

questions.q: A butterfly's wings show a ___ line of symmetry.
questions.explanation: A butterfly has a vertical line of symmetry down the middle.

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does the letter O have?
questions.explanation: A circular O has many lines of symmetry.

questions.q: What is the order of rotational symmetry of an equilateral triangle?
questions.explanation: It matches three times in a full turn.

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have?
questions.explanation: A regular hexagon has 6 lines of symmetry.
